title: Fourteen supplied krathong screenshots: morphology and preset routing

provenance.study_method: All fourteen original PNG files were opened and visually inspected at full resolution; a contact sheet was used only for comparison.
provenance.report_title: Thai Krathong 3D Builder — Deep Research Upgrade
provenance.report_role: Research provenance and implementation direction; prior package and test claims are not current validation evidence.
provenance.integration_status: New direct integration from recovered research report and supplied images; this is not a recovery of the original report-linked skill.zip.
provenance.source_archive_status: The report-linked sandbox:/mnt/data/skill.zip was unavailable in the inspected runtime.
provenance.image_policy: Screenshots are not bundled. Original filenames, file hashes and pixel metadata identify the supplied evidence; add verified source file IDs when available.

interpretation_rules: Observe first and separate visible facts from inferred structure. All material terms describe rendered appearance unless independently verified.
Physical dimensions, real thickness, hidden fold counts, support volumes and complete underside construction cannot be inferred reliably from one view.
Qualitative parameters describe a target shape; they are not measured generator values.
A recommended preset is a starting family, not a guarantee that the supplied preset reproduces every subtype.
Do not substitute generic flowers, candles or incense where none are visible. Exact accessory counts are stated only when directly visible.
No rendered similarity scores or image-match pass results are established by this catalog. Run current geometry and visual QA separately and record limitations.
The PNG DPI metadata is a screenshot encoding value and does not establish object scale.

references.subtype: Compact lime-green folded-leaf bowl with unobstructed round deck
references.mapping_fit: Family-level starting point; requires a compact low bowl variant, not the tall dark-green crown used by R13.
references.silhouette: Shallow circular body seen as an ellipse; many pointed crests make a dense compact perimeter. The front edge remains broad and low rather than forming long narrow spikes.

folds.width: Broad triangular/diamond-like faces relative to their visible height; pinched lower corners.
folds.tip: Pointed angular peaks, with small bevels and slight surface rounding.
folds.curl: Low transverse cupping and folded front side flaps; no large smooth spoon curl.
folds.overlap: Staggered faces overlap side to side; a low front band crosses the taller inner crests, with V-shaped seams.

references.arrangement: At least two distinguishable staggered bands of folded green motifs are visible. Exact whole-ring count and hidden rear construction are not established.
references.center: A large, nearly flat lime-green circular deck fills most of the opening. Faint radial seams converge near its centre; no central flowers or accessories are visible.
references.base: A continuous low yellow-green cylindrical side band is exposed below the leaf folds; the underside is hidden.
references.material: Green and yellow-green waxy/satin appearance, with subtle mottling and radial surface traces on the centre; this is a rendered appearance, not proof of real banana-leaf construction.
references.accessories: No candle, incense or flame is visible.
references.lighting: Dark rippling water with orange reflections, strongest behind and to image right; the object is brightly and broadly lit. Surface colour includes this warm illumination and cannot be sampled as an intrinsic material value without correction.
uncertainties: A single elevated view hides the bottom, rear fastenings and exact fold thickness.
Radial centre seams are visible; whether they represent separate leaf pieces or texture is uncertain.
variant_changes: Preserve the large empty centre and compact wall height.
Use broad folded facets and a continuous low base band; omit flowers and ceremonial accessories.
references.observed_view: Single elevated front/three-quarter view; not an orthographic measurement.
